The '''father''' of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Thurlow Harris]] served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Alliance during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Harris spent most of his life in his father's shadow.
